message: XVatsim 1.2.0 is available. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from GitHub.
release_notes: Closes the brain ownership recovery arc with protected brain-owned display, standby, phase, and authority decisions.
Allows CTAF/UNICOM fallback standby assist when no higher-priority live authority is available.
Fixes unsafe Center fail-open behavior when route authority metadata is unavailable.
Fixes X-Plane airway payload parsing so valid I-prefix waypoint rows such as IGSAM and IDEAL are retained.
Adds data-backed VATGlasses China FIR authority metadata coverage for route-sector Center matching.
Keeps source-owned fallback stable-key live consumption internal, default OFF, and brain-gated.
